It seems to be a take on various Korean modes of skin cleansing that are currently popular.  First off, let me say this sponge is very soft, much softer than anything I've ever used for exfoliating on my face. claims.text: Many reviewers find the pad gentle yet effective at exfoliating, leaving skin clean and smooth without scratching.
Several reviewers note the pad is smaller than expected, though some find the size suitable for facial use.
A recurring complaint is an odd or off-putting smell, which some say fades after a couple of weeks.
Some reviewers feel the product is not worth the money and is no rougher than a washcloth.
Reviewers appreciate that the pad can be washed, reused, and dries quickly.
